pre_result_plan.real_task: Verify source/test declaration coverage during an autonomous lab session.
pre_result_plan.observed_problem: A real agent invocation used `python3 -m ai_for_ai_lab.coverage --root .`; the module returned exit 0 with no stdout or stderr, so the agent initially treated a no-op as verification.
pre_result_plan.baseline: Direct module invocation returns exit 0 and zero JSON results.
pre_result_plan.hypothesis: Making the direct module invocation run the same coverage CLI will remove the ambiguous successful no-op while preserving the documented package command.
pre_result_plan.quality_control: Both invocation forms must emit the same valid JSON and exit code on a real repository; existing coverage behavior and the full suite must remain green.
pre_result_plan.overhead: Count reproduction, implementation, targeted/full tests, docs, checkpoint and publication.
pre_result_plan.stop_condition: Add only a thin module entry point and regression test; do not create a task runner or change coverage semantics. If the baseline cannot be reproduced, reject the change.

result.reason: Keep only the module-to-package CLI delegation and regression test; do not expand the runner or coverage semantics.
limitations: One mistaken invocation by one agent in this repository; no general error-rate or LLM-quality claim follows.
The canonical documented package command already worked, so the benefit is compatibility with a plausible Python module invocation, not new audit capability.
Elapsed time, tokens and maintenance cost were not compared; implementation, tests, documentation, checkpoint and publication are counted as overhead.
